fields.label: Background & Styling
fields.help: Customize the card background, borders, and rounded corners.

fields.label: Background Color
fields.help: Choose a background color for this card.

fields.label: Border Width
fields.help: Set the border thickness for the card container in pixels.

fields.label: Border Roundness
fields.help: Adjust the rounded corners of this card.

fields.label: Media Content
fields.help: Add an image and control its hover animations.

fields.label: Image
fields.help: Select or upload an image to display in the card.

fields.label: Show Image on Hover
fields.help: Enable this to hide the image by default and reveal it smoothly when the card is hovered.

fields.label: Statistic Details
fields.help: Enter the main number, labels, prefix, and suffix.

fields.label: Number Prefix
fields.help: Enter a symbol or text to display before the number (e.g., $, #).

fields.label: Statistic Number
fields.help: The main number to display in the statistic counter.

fields.label: Number Suffix
fields.help: Enter a symbol or text to display after the number (e.g., +, %, k).

fields.label: Description Label
fields.help: Short description text displaying below the statistic number.
